fields.description: Oasiz combines compact apartments and selected pool-equipped layouts in Dubai Silicon Oasis. Shared leisure spaces extend across the podium and roof; private pools belong only to specified configurations.

sources.label: Oasiz1 16-page branded plan pack, broker mirror
Oasiz branded prelaunch sales presentation, broker mirror
Property Finder Oasiz guide and commercial summary

reviewCoverage.identity: Oasiz identity checked against its own project page and named plan documents; related phases are separated.
reviewCoverage.location: The sources identify Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai. No coordinates or guaranteed travel times were invented.
reviewCoverage.residences: The published Studio–3 range was checked against the named layout families; convertible spaces are not counted as extra bedrooms.
reviewCoverage.areas: Numeric plan panels were rendered and visually inspected. Apartment, balcony and total figures are kept distinct; source conflicts are disclosed below.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Project facilities were checked against the cited own page or phase-specific guide. Unit pools are limited to the layouts that show them.
reviewCoverage.pricing: The price basis and source are disclosed. Historical launch references, averages and current availability are not treated as interchangeable.
reviewCoverage.payment: Published schedules were compared and arithmetic reviewed. Conflicting or incomplete current terms remain unresolved rather than merged.
reviewCoverage.handover: Forecast dates are separated from dated construction assessments; no actual handover is inferred from a percentage or elapsed forecast.
reviewCoverage.documents: Named brochures, plans and available commercial documents were reviewed. Numeric evidence, phase distinctions and document allocations are recorded in the project artifact.

overview: The illustrated plan separates enclosed accommodation from balcony space. Published type bands do not establish a particular unit’s approved net area or furnishing inventory.
research.locationNote: Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai. A proposed Metro reference is future connectivity; verify the actual route and transport status before relying on it.
research.priceNote: Danube’s FAQ retains studios around AED 699,000 while its headline marks Oasiz sold out. Property Finder retains AED 769,000; an older sales deck gives AED 775,000 as an average. These are different references, not current bookable stock.
research.paymentNote: The own page says 30/70 without a detailed calendar. The older branded presentation instead allocates 65% through handover and 35% across 35 months afterward. Property Finder places its final 35% on handover. These schedules cannot be merged; obtain the selected unit’s dated agreement.
research.handoverNote: The developer forecasts November 2027. Its 30 September 2026 internal inspection reports 35% progress and a slab at floor 20. This is a dated developer assessment, not regulatory certification or a promise of key delivery.

facts.label: Developer building scope
facts.value: 410 apartments advertised on the own project page; not an available-unit count.

unresolved: The retrieved plan pack uses area bands; endpoint sums may differ through rounding. Presidential is a marketing layout name, not an extra bedroom category.

A dated current contract, exact payment dates, live availability, approved parking and service charges, furnishing inventory and selected-unit pool obligations remain unverified. Images remain illustrative.
